## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>. [this is another way to link](https://quarto.org)

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#| echo: false
1 + 1
```
## demo

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
interviews_plotting <- read_csv(here("data", "interviews-plotting.csv"))
read_csv(".../data/interviews-plotting.csv")
interviews_plotting

 
```

### third level heading

#### forth level heading

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
